question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Rectify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rectify"** means to correct something or make it right. (सुधारना)

 
 
• **Example: **The technician was able to rectify the issue with the computer.
 
 
 
• **"Correct" **refers to making something accurate or free from errors. (सही करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher corrected the mistakes in the student's essay.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: Correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Count **(गिनती करना): To determine the total number of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She can count to ten in five different languages.
 
 
 
• **Consider **(विचार करना): To think about something carefully.
 
 
• **Example: **We need to consider all the options before making a decision.
 
 
 
• **Connect** (जोड़ना): To join or link together.
 
 
• **Example:** The new bridge will connect the two cities.
 
 

50:Tbd1,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**</
